runLabel: U-PROOF (known) - Stage 6/7 - Agent 06 QA & Launch Auditor

output.summary: Reviewed research_report v1, site_blueprint v1, design_system v1, content_pack v1, and build_plan v1 as an independent auditor. Overall the artifacts are reasonably disciplined about not claiming unverified live fixes, and content_pack in particular is commendably explicit about the shop-catalog caveat. However, several concrete defects were found: (1) content_pack's page-by-page section descriptions (e.g. Home page "no unpriced or '#' cards", full 5-category tiles) read as accomplished fact in the per-page body even though the summary caveats only the /shop page explicitly - this is an internal inconsistency between the artifact's own summary discipline and its page-level copy, which could be misread as claiming fixes beyond what was verified. (2) build_plan's visible ticket list (only partially available due to truncation) does not yet show explicit tickets for several research_report-flagged issues: the address/contact-page vs WooCommerce shipping-origin mismatch (Vereeniging vs Edenvale), the future-dated/fake-author blog placeholder cleanup beyond the 3 Help & Advice articles, the order-notification email misconfiguration (going to Creative Touch instead of client, and leftover third-party from-address) noted in PROJECT FACTS, the 10Web trial-domain asset hardcoding re-verification, and the Elementor-vs-10Web builder engine discrepancy noted in research - none of these appear as their own tickets in the visible portion of build_plan, and it is not certain from the truncated artifact that they exist further down; this must be confirmed with the human reviewer rather than assumed dropped. (3) design_system's vision-limitation disclaimer is honestly stated and is correctly not overridden by build_plan, which explicitly scopes AMBER-gated ticket work without claiming visual fidelity to any real live screenshots - this is consistent and is not a defect, but is flagged as an area requiring explicit human visual sign-off before CONTROLLED ACTIVATION TESTING. (4) No invented prices, pages, or credentials were found; all pricing in site_blueprint, design_system references, and content_pack traces cleanly to PROJECT FACTS. (5) content_pack and build_plan both correctly keep RED-tier items (DNS, payment credentials, shipping) out of scope, consistent with doctrine. (6) research_report itself surfaces a new/unresolved technical claim (Elementor 4.2.4 vs prior-recorded 10Web WVC builder) that is acknowledged but not turned into any follow-up verification ticket in the visible build_plan - this is a coverage gap. Given the ticket-coverage gaps and the Home-page-copy overconfidence inconsistency, this pass is not clean; it surfaces real planning-artifact defects that need author revision and human review before this moves further down the pipeline. QA is not yet at zero P0/P1, so per doctrine this does not clear the artifacts for advancement without correction.

defects.title: content_pack Home-page section copy overstates fixed status beyond its own stated caveat
defects.evidence: content_pack's top-level summary explicitly caveats only the /shop page ('explicitly notes in its own content that only one category was confirmed rendering live... this should be verified before publishing'), but the Home page section list asserts as fact that the Featured Products strip has 'no unpriced or #' cards' and that Shop by Category tiles link to all 5 categories 'so visitors are never limited to a single visible product' - phrasing that reads as an accomplished state rather than a planned content proposal, inconsistent with the artifact's own admitted uncertainty about live catalog rendering.

defects.title: build_plan does not visibly ticket the Contact-page vs WooCommerce shipping-origin address mismatch
defects.evidence: research_report explicitly raises 'Address discrepancy: live Contact page (Vereeniging) vs WooCommerce shipping origin (Edenvale)' as a risk of checkout/customer confusion, but no ticket addressing reconciliation of this address discrepancy appears in the visible portion of build_plan's ticket list; this must be confirmed against the untruncated build_plan before assuming it is covered.

defects.title: build_plan does not visibly ticket order-notification email misconfiguration flagged in PROJECT FACTS
defects.evidence: PROJECT FACTS records that order-notification emails go to Creative Touch's own address instead of the client's business inbox, and the from-address is a leftover third-party domain - both explicitly 'flagged, not resolved.' No ticket in the visible build_plan content addresses WooCommerce email settings remediation.

defects.title: build_plan does not visibly ticket re-verification of the 10Web trial-domain asset hardcoding
defects.evidence: PROJECT FACTS notes hardcoded 10Web trial-domain (allowed-pony.10web.cloud) assets were stripped from on-disk build files but 'not independently re-verified live since' as of the 2026-09-02 audit; research_report does not re-confirm this live either. No ticket in the visible build_plan content proposes a fresh live check of this specific item before launch.

defects.title: build_plan does not visibly ticket cleanup of future-dated placeholder blog posts / fake author handle beyond the 3 named Help & Advice articles
defects.evidence: research_report flags 'placeholder articles with future publication dates (June 26, 2026) and admin author handle ctsa-admin' as a homepage teaser issue distinct from (though related to) the Help & Advice hub; content_pack addresses the Help & Advice articles themselves, but no ticket explicitly addresses removing/fixing the future-dated placeholder posts and author handle as a WordPress/blog data issue.

defects.title: Builder engine discrepancy (Elementor 4.2.4 vs prior-recorded 10Web WVC) surfaced by research but not converted into a build_plan verification ticket
defects.evidence: research_report states 'Product metadata reveals Elementor 4.2.4, whereas prior audit recorded 10Web WVC builder engine; non-JS fetches returned empty body tags for product detail URLs, requiring headless/browser DOM verification' - a material technical-stack ambiguity with implications for build_plan's Elementor-ticket approach, yet no ticket in the visible build_plan addresses confirming which builder is actually authoritative before executing Elementor-based tickets.

defects.title: build_plan ticket list only partially visible due to artifact truncation - full coverage cannot be confirmed
defects.evidence: The supplied build_plan content is marked '_truncated: true' with only a partial preview of tickets; several coverage gaps flagged above are based on the visible portion only and could theoretically be addressed in truncated sections - this audit could not fully verify ticket-to-issue traceability and flags this limitation explicitly rather than assuming either full coverage or full gaps.

defects.title: Design_system vision-limitation disclaimer is honest but no explicit build_plan gate requires human visual sign-off against live staging before activation
defects.evidence: design_system v1 explicitly states 'A human designer must visually verify the live staging environment prior to final implementation' due to no real vision/screenshot input, and build_plan correctly keeps tickets at AMBER (human-approval-gated) without claiming visual fidelity - this is handled honestly, but no ticket or note in the visible build_plan explicitly names 'human visual verification against live staging' as a required checklist item before CONTROLLED ACTIVATION TESTING, leaving this dependent on the human reviewer remembering the design_system caveat independently.

defects.title: No invented facts detected in reviewed artifacts
defects.evidence: Cross-checked all pricing cited in site_blueprint, design_system, and content_pack (Liquid Rubber 5L R790/20L R1790, Fibre Filler 5L R790/20L R1590, Bonding Liquid Primer 5L R500/20L R1500, etc.) against PROJECT FACTS pricing table; all values match exactly with no fabricated prices, pages, or credentials found in the visible content.
